text:
Done. 9 tests pass.

**Files:**
- `app.py` — Flask app factory with SQLite storage, base62 codes
- `test_app.py` — pytest suite (isolated temp DB per test)

**API:**
| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/shorten` | `{"url": "https://..."}` → 201 with `code`, `short_url` |
| GET | `/<code>` | 302 redirect, increments click count |
| GET | `/api/urls/<code>` | Metadata: url, clicks |
| DELETE | `/api/urls/<code>` | 204 on success |

Invalid URLs (non-http/https) get 400; unknown codes 404.

Run: `python3 app.py` — test: `python3 -m pytest -q`
